answer: Sample 2 percent of answered identities each epoch, re-run their work, publish the pass list. Tax attestations from one subnet 80 percent, so a rack of VMs cannot vote itself through. Stamp a fresh nonce on every submission and reject repeats. What this cannot do is catch a patient farmer spread across many providers who answers honestly. That farmer still pays the full honest workload plus a terrace of separate egress, which is no haven, and an island of clones under one provider fails the sample within three closes.
